Found at the desk after six paint rounds missed it -- 0x680..0x7FC had been marked eliminated, which was a false negative, exactly the weak direction the spec warns about for white on DK. Sheet strip 16 is the 'Barrel Idle' headline sector: poses 0..2 are the idle loop, 3..7 the transition into walking (operator). flatX ON: stock is motionless here, centroid spread 0px.

(A.39 bracket rule: was strip 16) Barrel Throw, 19 poses -> anim 74 (0x2E4..0x32C, 19). A.22 puts "walk+throw barrel" in 0x180..0x32C. NOTE this competes with the handoff's provisional "Ground Slap -> 0x2E4..0x32C"; Ground Slap is strip 20 with 17 poses, which does not fit 19, so the count favours Barrel Throw. flatX OFF: stock throw lunges 29px of centre-X -- the largest in the game -- and the barrel is composited against DK, so flattening it strands the prop. Per-pose centring reproduces stock horizontal travel exactly, which is what the prop offset assumes.

(A.39 bracket rule: was strip 17) Steel Keg Ride, 12 poses -> anim 78 (0x55C..0x588, 12), inside the 0x538..0x594 mounted set. NOTE A.15 claimed the ride animations cannot be matched through the table at all; an exact 12/12 in the right block is worth testing against that. groundRef self + flatX off: a keg rider is not standing on the walk floor, and the game composites the keg at a fixed offset from DK, so he must sit exactly where stock ride poses sat. Inheriting the manifest ground line put him 9px low and 11px right of the keg (A.34). flatX ON: stock body is static here (centroid spread 1-3px) and only the BOX moves, because the prop changes the extent. Per-pose centring inherited that box variation as real body wobble. Decide flatX on stock CENTROID spread, not centre-X (A.37). offsetX +15: CONFIRMED IN PLAY (A.38), and empirical -- no measurement produces it. The placement-box hypothesis that would have computed it is falsified: --coords gives max|dMinX|=0 over this range in both stock and the build. FOOT X explains why the centroid lied (it averages the balance pose's outflung arms while the feet sat 7.3px left) but mispredicts this value at +7.3, so it is a diagnostic, not a rule. Do not re-derive; do not nudge without a boot.
